components.css: .ds-button-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e1e1e1);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#f7f7f7);color:var(--bad,#aa4538);font:500 13px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif);white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,filter 150ms}.ds-button-danger:hover{background:var(--bad-soft,color-mix(in srgb,#aa4538 8%,#f7f7f7))}.ds-button-danger:focus-visible{background:var(--surface-3,#eaeaea);color:var(--ink,#303030)}.ds-button-danger:active{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-button-danger:disabled{background:var(--surface-3,#eaeaea);color:var(--ink-3,#626262);border-color:transparent;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Thread filter
components.description: Loaded-title search with a neutral focus surface and no focus halo.
components.html: <label class="ds-thread-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m15.3 15.3 5.2 5.2"/></svg><input aria-label="Filter loaded threads" placeholder="Filter threads…"></label>
components.css: .ds-thread-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink-3,#626262);max-width:240px}.ds-thread-search:focus-within{background:var(--surface-2,#efefef)}.ds-thread-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:5px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#303030);font:400 12px/18px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-thread-search input:focus{outline:none;box-shadow:none;caret-color:var(--accent-ink,#2159a0)}.ds-thread-search input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3,#626262);opacity:1}

components.name: Conversation tabs
components.description: Threads and Orclings share the same navigation column.
components.css: .ds-conversation-tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}.ds-conversation-tabs button{height:28px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-3,#626262);font:400 12px/18px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-conversation-tabs button:hover{background:var(--surface-3,#eaeaea)}.ds-conversation-tabs button[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--navigation-soft,#e8f0fa);color:var(--navigation-ink,#2159a0)}.ds-conversation-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#2159a0);outline-offset:2px;background:var(--surface-3,#eaeaea);color:var(--ink,#303030)}

components.name: Task filters
components.description: Distinct padded targets with a soft selected state.
components.css: .ds-task-filters{display:flex;gap:4px}.ds-task-filters button{min-height:28px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-3,#626262);font:400 12px/18px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-task-filters button:hover,.ds-task-filters button:focus-visible{background:var(--surface-2,#efefef);color:var(--ink,#303030)}.ds-task-filters button[aria-checked="true"]{background:var(--navigation-soft,#e8f0fa);color:var(--navigation-ink,#2159a0)}

components.name: User prompt
components.description: A quiet boundary around the user's message; assistant responses remain unboxed.
components.html: Help people connect their first project, then give them a clear next step.
components.css: .ds-user-prompt{max-width:520px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e1e1e1);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bubble,#fff);color:var(--bubble-ink,#303030);box-shadow:none;font:400 14px/1.55 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}

components.name: Composer
components.description: Raised shell, distinct writing area, and compact transparent controls. This example shows appearance only.
components.html: main
components.css: .ds-composer{container:ds-composer / inline-size;max-width:520px;width:100%}.ds-composer-shell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e1e1e1);border-radius:11px;background:var(--surface-2,#efefef);box-shadow:none}.ds-composer-input{display:block;min-height:48px;padding:9px 8px;resize:vertical;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--composer-input,#fff);color:var(--ink,#303030);font:400 13px/1.6 var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-composer-input:focus{outline:none;box-shadow:none;caret-color:var(--accent-ink,#2159a0)}.ds-composer-input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3,#626262)}.ds-composer-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;padding:3px 2px 0}.ds-composer-foot button{min-height:28px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#303030);font:400 12px/18px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-composer-foot button:hover,.ds-composer-foot button:focus-visible{background:var(--surface-3,#eaeaea)}.ds-composer-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:1;gap:3px;min-width:130px}.ds-composer-model{margin-right:auto}.ds-composer-foot .ds-composer-send{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;min-height:26px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent,#2865c2);color:var(--accent-fg,#fff)}.ds-composer-git{padding:1px 5px;color:var(--ink-3,#626262);font:400 11px/16px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}@container ds-composer (max-width:440px){.ds-composer-actions{flex-basis:100%;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}}

components.name: Inset work panel
components.description: Opaque paper inside a neutral canvas, separated with a fine border and no cast shadow.
components.html:
Changes
Review the current changes alongside the conversation.
components.css: .ds-work-panel{margin:0 12px 12px;max-width:520px;min-height:160px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e1e1e1);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#303030);box-shadow:none;font:400 13px/20px var(--font-sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-work-panel-header{padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e1e1e1)}.ds-work-panel-body{padding:12px;color:var(--ink-2,#444)}

narrative.northStar: A calm place to think with coding agents
narrative.overview:
OpenOrc is a compact desktop workspace for several projects at once. A shared sidebar keeps projects and conversations visible; the conversation occupies the center, and an optional work panel holds review and tools. The approved Cursor-inspired composition uses neutral gray, white, or charcoal grounds with blue accents in the OpenOrc palette. The Cursor palette uses the same structure with monochrome accents.

This record describes the built desktop interface. It preserves the workflows in [PRODUCT.md](../../PRODUCT.md), including drafts, task authorization, Orcling privacy, and project context. Packaged application artwork is unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: One resizable sidebar with expandable project groups and Threads/Orclings tabs.
Compact toolbar titles, bounded user prompts, and unboxed assistant responses.
Flat neutral surfaces, a distinct writing area, and an inset work panel.
Independent action, navigation, and content accents across saved palettes.
Existing keyboard controls, window chrome, split panes, and recovery states remain available.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Read live palette roles instead of hardcoding OpenOrc colors into components.

rules.name: The Opaque Work Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep reading, writing, and tool content opaque when Transparent surroundings is enabled.

rules.name: The Save Feedback Rule
rules.body: Announce actual saves and errors in normal document flow; leave the idle state empty.

rules.name: The Recovery Visibility Rule
rules.body: Keep actionable resets and unresolved attempts visible. Preserve the reset attempt's state when the provider inventory changes.

dos: Do keep neutral OpenOrc and Cursor grounds with accents on controls, selection, and content.
Do preserve saved widths, palettes, custom colors, independent accent roles, and semantic statuses.
Do preserve native window-control clearance, keyboard access, private Orcling memory, drafts, and existing workflows.
Do keep project actions stationary on hover and composer controls reachable in narrow columns.
donts: Don't reintroduce a separate icon rail, blue-tinted OpenOrc grounds, or serif task headings.
Don't turn synthetic preview identities, activity, or account data into product claims.
